## Open findings

### High (16)

- `byok-active-state-not-indicated` — **ByokSection** — Active BYOK state is not explicitly indicated — inferred only from an inverse-labeled toggle
- `coding-credentials-wrong-fixture-stories` — **CodingCredentialsSection** — Both stories serve the wrong (`forge`) fixture — the real agent-provider form is never screenshotted, and the empty story misrepresents the shipped empty state — `client/stories/msw/settings-handlers-personal.ts:21`
- `coding-identity-load-failure-silent-overwrite` — **CodingIdentitySection** — Load failure leaves an editable form defaulting to "Initiator" — the real policy can be silently overwritten — `client/settings/sections/CodingIdentitySection.svelte:107`
- `coding-identity-raw-user-ids` — **CodingIdentitySection** — Designated "Member" dropdown shows raw user ids instead of human labels — `client/settings/sections/CodingIdentitySection.svelte:131`
- `group-provider-save-no-feedback` — **GroupProviderSection** — `Save` gives no in-flight or disabled feedback (double-submit risk)
- `group-provider-select-unlabeled-no-focus` — **GroupProviderSection** — `Select` is unlabeled and has no visible keyboard focus ring
- `guest-mode-load-error-no-retry` — **GuestModeSection** — Load error is a raw-text dead-end with no retry
- `guest-mode-state-no-signifier-inverted` — **GuestModeSection** — Current on/off state has no signifier and the color emphasis is inverted — `client/settings/sections/GuestModeSection.svelte:65`
- `mcp-empty-state-no-explanation` — **McpSection** — Empty state is a bare pair of buttons with no explanation — `client/settings/sections/McpSection.svelte:165`
- `mcp-url-field-cramped` — **McpSection** — Primary URL field is cramped to ~200px while most of the row is empty — `client/settings/sections/McpSection.svelte:262`
- `members-delete-no-confirm` — **MembersSection** — Removing a member revokes access with no confirmation — `client/settings/sections/MembersSection.svelte:107`
- `memory-meta-text-invisible` — **MemorySection** — Record meta text (`--fg4`) is effectively invisible — `client/shared/tokens.css:72`
- `memory-no-privacy-explanation` — **MemorySection** — No explanatory copy for a privacy-sensitive capture feature
- `release-subscription-loading-looks-unsubscribed` — **ReleaseSubscriptionSection** — Loading is indistinguishable from "unsubscribed", and defaults to the green Subscribe CTA before state is known — `client/settings/sections/ReleaseSubscriptionSection.svelte:75`
- `task-provider-select-no-label` — **TaskProviderSection** — Task-instance `<select>` has no programmatic label
- `tools-preset-active-state-invisible` — **ToolsSection** — Preset selector's active state is invisible at rest and its indicator is detached
